entities.name: Thousandfold Refraction of Rabiah
entities.description: A mysterious event in which Rabiah was reproduced one thousand times, creating a thousand and one virtually identical worlds.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: A plane that was reproduced one thousand times.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: Person of Rabiah of whom only five incarnations were created, one per color of mana; arrived on Dominaria in the Ice Age and was trapped by the Shard.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Event after which Taysir was born not long afterwards.

entities.name: Shard of Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Shard that trapped Taysir of Rabiah on Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane Taysir arrived on during the Ice Age.

events.summary: Rabiah is reproduced one thousand times along with all its people, places and objects, except that only five incarnations of Taysir of Rabiah are created.
events.quote: only five incarnations of Taysir of Rabiah were created, one of each color of mana

relations.note: Taysir was trapped by the Shard.
